# File-Level Audit Inventory

Generated 2026-10-13 from the release commit `14d1350e` (the state at the start of the audit) and the current working tree. Every file has an explicit disposition. Nothing was deleted in this audit; the only removals are the pre-protocol pilot files listed in section 3, removed earlier the same day before the release commit.

**Evidence status:** *verified* = regenerated byte-identically by the from-scratch reproduction; *confirmatory* = pre-registered test evaluated once after a freeze; *validation only* / *exploratory* = not confirmatory evidence; *frozen* = covered by a SHA-256 freeze file.

## 3. Pre-protocol pilot files removed before the release (commit `c43e30a2`, local history only)

The pilot (1,000-record T1-only sample, one circuit, homogeneous device) preceded the pre-registered study. Nothing in the final pipeline imported or read these files (checked by import tracing and a full import smoke test). Its results are summarised, as pre-protocol evidence only, in `docs/PROTOCOL.md` §8 and `docs/research/STAGE1_RESEARCH_PROPOSAL.md` §7. The files remain in the local `dev-history` branch and in the untouched Desktop copy of the project.
